item.name: Threads
item.summary: Publish Threads posts and replies, moderate replies and read posts and insights.
item.description:
Connect workflows to Threads, Meta's text-first social network, through the Threads API. Everyday steps publish text, image, video and carousel posts and replies, read all your posts and the replies to a post, and read post and account insights and your publishing limits.

Each of the 25 Threads API endpoints this release covers has its own step: media containers and publishing, reposts and deletion, posts and keyword search, replies, conversations and reply moderation, profiles and mentions, locations, insights and embedding. A connection is one Threads account with its user access token.
item.setup_summary: Create a Meta app with the Threads use case, authorize the Threads account with the permissions your steps need, and save its long-lived user access token, as the connection's secret.
